results.title: Iran and Oman make progress on a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, officials say
results.description: Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmail Baghaei said the bilateral talks with Oman are focused on "establishing safe inbound and outbound shipping lanes," routes that "uphold sovereign rights.

results.title: Moviegoers Flee Colombia Theatre As Audience Member Triggers Extreme 'Fart Attack' During Spider-Man Screening
results.description: A screening of 'Spider-Man' in Colombia was disrupted when moviegoers evacuated the theater due to an extreme flatulence incident.
